COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialized }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_snapshot = debt }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt = debt }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_retirement_total = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_cost_tier = 0 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_reconcile_debt = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialize = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta = debt }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_snapshot }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta > 0 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta < 0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_delta }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction = -1 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_SAU }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_SAU }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_SAU = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_UAE }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_UAE }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_UAE = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_unassigned_reduction }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_retirement_total = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_retire }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt min = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_snapshot = debt }
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_change_other_debt = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_reconcile_debt = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_change }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied < 0 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = -1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied > debt }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = debt }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { debt_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied }
			modify_debt_effect = yes
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt_applied }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_other_debt min = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_snapshot = debt }
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = PER }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_start days > 179 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_start days > 364 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 3 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_cost_tier = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier }
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_clear_costs = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 1 }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_cost_1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 2 }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_cost_2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier = 3 }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_cost_3
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_cost_tier = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_desired_tier }
			ingame_update_setup = yes
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_observer = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = PER }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_active }
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_active
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_seen
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_start
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_entry_debt = debt }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_entry_gdp = gdp_total }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_threshold = gdp_total }
				multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_threshold = 0.25 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_borrowing_live = 0 }
			}
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_audit_war_borrowing = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_active }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_audit_war_borrowing = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_borrowing_frozen = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_borrowing_live }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_start days > 179 }
					check_variable = {
						var = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_borrowing_frozen
						value = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_threshold
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
					check_variable = { debt > 0 }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_price_of_victory
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_policy_unlocked
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf.10 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_active
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iran_war_start
		}
		COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_refresh_war_costs = yes
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_cancelled > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { debt_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_cancelled }
			multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = -1 }
			modify_debt_effect = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_debt_snapshot = debt }
			ingame_update_setup = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_request_kuwait_forgiveness = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_reconcile_debt = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_postwar = yes
				country_exists = KUW
				NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_requested }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_principal_KUW > 0 }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_requested
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgiveness_pending days = 30 }
			KUW = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf.20 }
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_claim_kuwait = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_postwar = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_claimed }
			}
			add_state_claim = 172
			add_state_claim = 488
			add_war_support = 0.05
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_claimed
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_ultimatum = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_can_ultimatum = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_ultimatum_issued
			set_temp_variable = { wargoal_on = KUW }
			set_temp_variable = { wargoal_type = 2 }
			add_threat_from_wargoal_effect = yes
			create_wargoal = {
				type = take_state_focus
				target = KUW
				generator = { 172 488 }
				expire = 180
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_ultimatum_tt
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seize_kuwait_treasury = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_invaded_kuwait
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_controls_kuwait = yes
				country_exists = KUW
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_treasury_seizure_consumed }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				KUW = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_treasury_seizure_consumed
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount = KUW.treasury }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount = 0.25 }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount min = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_cap = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_cap = 0.10 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount > COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_cap }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_cap }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount > 0 }
				}
				KUW = {
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = IRQ.COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seizure_amount }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_conquest_relief = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_owns_kuwait = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_invaded_kuwait
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_conquest_relief_consumed }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_conquest_relief_consumed
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_forgive_kuwait_principal = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_price_of_victory }
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_price_of_victory
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_captured_assets_repair days = 180 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf.30 }
			ingame_update_setup = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integrate_kuwait = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_invoice = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_invoice = 0.05 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_can_integrate = yes
				NOT = { has_political_power < 100 }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_integrated
			add_political_power = -100
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			172 = { add_core_of = IRQ }
			488 = { add_core_of = IRQ }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_tt
			ingame_update_setup = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_fund_recovery = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_invoice = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_invoice = 0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_debt_cap = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_debt_cap = 0.20 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_postwar = yes
				has_war = no
				has_idea = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_price_of_victory
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				NOT = { has_political_power < 50 }
				check_variable = { var = debt value = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_debt_cap compare = less_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_invoice }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_political_power = -50
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_price_of_victory
			ingame_update_setup = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialize = yes
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_cost_display = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_integration_cost_display = 0.05 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_cost_display = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_cost_display = 0.02 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_debt_cap_display = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_recovery_debt_cap_display = 0.20 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_reconcile_debt = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_observer = yes
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_owns_kuwait = yes has_war = no has_stability > 0.50 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_stable_kuwait }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_stable_kuwait
				}
			}
			else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_stable_kuwait }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seize_kuwait_treasury = yes
			COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_conquest_relief = yes
		}
	}
}
